_comment: Affiliate link layer. While meta.affiliate_mode is false, CTAs use 'url' with rel='nofollow noopener'. When true, they use 'affiliate_url' (rel='nofollow sponsored noopener'), falling back to 'url' if affiliate_url is null. Optional 'bonus' shows only while today <= 'bonus_expires' (YYYY-MM-DD); expired bonuses are auto-dropped at build without editing this file.
